name: readlines
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fprintf(fid, 'a\nb\nc'); fclose(fid); lines = readlines(fname); delete(fname); r1 = double(numel(lines) >= 3);
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip via tempname). readlines returns string array -- at least 3 lines (some engines append empty trailing string).
